{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0686","text":"SILVERBRIDGE MUTUAL
Cross-Team Alignment Session: Nutmeg Migration
Organizer: Arjun
Date/Time: Thursday, 10:00-11:00
Location: Conference Room 4B / Virtual Bridge
Invitees: Claims Operations, Underwriting Systems, Policy Administration, Data Governance, Actuarial Reporting, IT Infrastructure, Vendor Management, Compliance (19 total)

Purpose:
To align all impacted functions on the status of the Nutmeg migration and to confirm the cutover approach for the policy archive.

Agenda (approximate):
1. Opening remarks and objectives (Arjun), 5 min
2. Round-robin status updates from each workstream, approx. 3 min per team
   - Claims Operations (Mei Pruitt)
   - Underwriting Systems (Will Dube)
   - Policy Administration (Ximena Eriksen)
   - Data Governance (Soren Quintero)
   - Remaining teams as time permits
3. Review of the consolidated RAID log, 10 min
4. DECISION REQUIRED: Policy archive cutover. Phased versus single weekend (Vera Ekwueme, Aisha Mbatha), 10 min
5. Open floor / AOB
6. Recap of actions

Pre-reading:
The current status tracker and RAID log are posted in the shared Nutmeg folder. Attendees are asked to review these BEFORE the session. Item 2 will largely restate the tracker contents for the benefit of those who have not yet reviewed it.

Please note that ALL invitees are expected to attend, including delegates where principals are unavailable. Item 4 primarily concerns Policy Administration, Data Governance and IT Infrastructure. However, all teams are requested to remain on the call for visibility.

Should you be unable to attend, kindly submit your written update to Arjun by close of business Wednesday.

Regards,
Arjun
Programme Lead, Nutmeg Migration"},{"spec_id":"spec_0687","text":"Hey everyone!! 🎉 Okay so the Spring Gala is officially BEHIND us and honestly what a night, you are all superstars ✨

BUT we do need to talk about the climate control failure in the East Gallery 😬 Humidity spiked for about 90 minutes during the event, and two of the loaned pieces under the Bakshi contract were in that room. Gemma Bakshi's team has asked for a written account by end of next week, and the contract has some language about "environmental excursions" that we need to get RIGHT.

So I'd love to grab an hour with the crew, Tuesday 2-3pm in the Board Room! Rough plan:
- Timeline walkthrough: when did the sensors trip, who saw what (Nils, you have the logs, right??)
- Why the alert didn't reach facilities (Nico + Odette, I know you two see this differently, so let's hash it out!)
- Conservation check on the loaned works (Grace)
- What we tell the lender and what we change before the summer exhibition (Bea, contracts hat on please!)

I'm inviting 13 of us, so security, facilities, conservation, events, registrar, and development. I know that's a lot of folks, but everybody touched some piece of that night and I don't want to piece the story together from 10 different emails 🙈

Please bring your notes, your memories, and your BEST problem-solving energy!! No blame, just learning 💪🖼️

Calendar invite coming in a sec!"},{"spec_id":"spec_0688","text":"FYI, adding you all to this. Mostly I need everyone's inputs on value-stream ideas for the Hakimi contract ramp. If you've got thoughts, drop them in the tracker beforehand [link] and we'll just walk through them. —Tess

Subject: Brainstorm: Hakimi contract throughput levers
When: Wed 1:30-2:15pm
Where: Line 3 mezzanine huddle room / Teams [link]
Attendees: Cleo Bramwell, Zainab Jovanovic, Olu Brennan, Tess

Quick ideation sync to capture OEE uplift and takt alignment opportunities ahead of the Hakimi volume step-up. Looking for kaizen candidates, SMED quick wins, and any bottleneck intel from the floor. No deck needed.

Current baseline metrics: [link]"},{"spec_id":"spec_0689","text":"Folks, forwarding the invite below. I know nobody's itching to relive the Garnet 2.0 rollout week, but we owe the client a straight answer, and I'd rather we figure it out around one table than through a pile of emails. Bring coffee and an open mind. — Erik

---------- Forwarded message ----------
Subject: Garnet 2.0 data reconciliation incident: postmortem
When: Friday, 9:00-10:00am
Where: Room Juniper (dial-in in calendar)
Attendees: Mei Gunawardena, Leon Cho, Liam Oyelaran, Ines Iversen, Erik

Background: On the Garnet 2.0 benchmarking deliverable, the cost-baseline figures in the client's interim report didn't tie to the source extract. The client spotted it before we did. We pulled the report and reissued Tuesday.

Agenda:
1. Timeline of what happened, from extract to client send (Liam, 10 min)
2. Where the reconciliation step got skipped, and why the review didn't catch it (Mei, 15 min)
3. Leon and Ines have different views on whether the fix is a process checkpoint or a tooling change. Let's hear both and land on one (20 min)
4. What we say to the client partner on Monday, and who says it (Erik, 10 min)
5. Owners and dates for follow-ups (5 min)

Please read the reissue memo beforehand so we don't spend time recapping. This is about the process, not pointing fingers. Everyone here did their honest best under a tight deadline."},{"spec_id":"spec_0690","text":"Subject: Fjord initiative retro (since we apparently need one)

Hi Jada, Nico, Wen,

Given how the Fjord initiative launch went, I think it's probably worth us sitting down. I've blocked an HOUR on Thursday at 3pm. That's 3pm London, Wen, not 3pm your time like last time, though I realise that was apparently unclear. If that's 10am for you, I'm sure you'll manage.

No formal agenda. I'd just like to understand, as a group, how the client ended up seeing the unapproved draft. I'm sure there's a perfectly good explanation. I'd also like to talk through "what went well," if anyone can think of anything.

Please come having actually looked at the timeline doc this time.

Thanks SO much,
Sam"}]}
